drag-ghost.$description: The 'ghost' of an entry plate dragged onto a chat in the sidebar (a slice 3 acceptance decision): a copy of the plate under the cursor, quiet but readable.

ghost-max-width.$description: Largest width of the 'ghost' of the dragged plate (338 px at a 13 px root): a wide plate does not cover the whole sidebar.

ghost-offset.$description: Offset of the 'ghost' from the pointer to the right and down (13 px at a 13 px root): the chat under the pointer stays visible.
